text: Because the board calls a post new when its update time moves, not only when its text or comments change. CL10's post and that thread are updated by sessions all the time (status, pictures), so they come back as new after you read them. CL21 noted this and left it; I sent it back to CL21 to fix: new only for text or comments you have not seen. CL21 answers here when it is done.
